entrypoints.summary: An arbitrary external account can call ConsolidationController.snapBalances() while no consolidation is in progress; the call forwards to the target strategy snapshot operation.
The owner-only ConsolidationController.requestConsolidation() performs targetStrategy.snapBalances() at the end of its transaction.

impact.affected_asset: Availability of the validator migration/consolidation process from sweeping validators to the compounding strategy.
impact.attacker_capability: A permissionless transaction sender can front-run owner consolidation attempts with cooldown-refreshing snapshot calls.
impact.security_effect: Indefinite denial of service of validator-consolidation requests.

causal_trace.summary: Before a consolidation is in progress, the controller exposes snapBalances() to external callers and forwards it to the target strategy.
The forwarded snapshot records shared freshness timing and rejects a subsequent snapshot until SNAP_BALANCES_DELAY (420 seconds) has elapsed; an untrusted caller can refresh that timing state.

requestConsolidation() unconditionally calls targetStrategy.snapBalances() as its final snapshot. A prior attacker snapshot within the cooldown makes this call revert with "Snap too soon," atomically reverting the owner transaction.

By monitoring the public mempool and submitting a snapshot before each owner attempt, an attacker can repeatedly reset the cooldown and indefinitely block validator consolidation at reported minimal gas cost.

failure.operation: targetStrategy.snapBalances() invoked by requestConsolidation() reverts with "Snap too soon" when the shared 420-second cooldown has been refreshed.

primary_invariant.statement: A permissionless snapshot freshness update must not make the required snapshot step of an owner-only consolidation transition unavailable.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The same cooldown-protected targetStrategy.snapBalances() operation is publicly reachable before consolidation and mandatory at the end of requestConsolidation(), so a public call can force the mandatory call to revert.

raw_refs.role: primary audit finding and reported resolution

provenance.source_id: OGVC-03: Permissionless snapBalances() Can DoS Consolidation Requests

quality.review_notes: The primary audit report provides the finding-specific Solidity excerpts, cooldown condition, transaction-revert mechanism, attacker scenario, and a reported resolution. No independently fetched assessed source, PR #2820 diff, execution trace, or regression test is in this bundle. The resolution is therefore recorded as report-grounded rather than independently patch-verified.

remediation.invariant_restored: The reported resolution skips the requestConsolidation() snapshot when a snapshot was already taken within the preceding 420 seconds, preventing a recent public snapshot from forcing the consolidation transaction to revert; it also permits verification of qualifying pre-consolidation snapshots while consolidation is in progress.
mitigation_classes: conditional snapshot execution based on recent freshness
separation of permissionless snapshot timing from privileged lifecycle availability
